title: When Should the Teacher Move? Temporal Coupling and Stability in Self On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2606.03532v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Self on-policy distillation trains a student policy against a teacher derived from its own parameter history, yet the teacher's update schedule -- which governs the \emph{temporal coupling} between teacher and student -- has not been systematically studied as a stability variable. Through a controlled schedule sweep on Qwen3-8B, we establish that \emph{isolation periods}, defined as complete teacher freezing between updates, are the key structural property enabling stable learning, not teacher age. To characterize these underlying training dynamics, we introduce a diagnostic framework of temporal KL structure, refresh shock, and length-tail risk. This framework further uncovers \emph{state-oblivious collapse}: optimal short-horizon fixed schedules catastrophically fail under long-horizon training because a clock-driven refresh can copy a transiently drifting student into the teacher in a single, irreversible step. translated_title: 教师何时应该移动？自我在线策略蒸馏中的时间耦合与稳定性
translated_abstract: 自我在线策略蒸馏通过让学生策略与一个源自其自身参数历史的教师进行训练，然而教师的更新时间表——它决定了教师与学生之间的时间耦合——尚未被系统地研究作为稳定性变量。通过在Qwen3-8B上进行受控的时间表扫描，我们确立了隔离期（定义为更新之间教师完全冻结）是实现稳定学习的关键结构属性，而非教师年龄。为了刻画这些底层的训练动态，我们引入了一个包含时间KL结构、刷新冲击和长度尾部风险的诊断框架。该框架进一步揭示了状态遗忘崩溃现象：最优的短程固定时间表在长程训练中会灾难性地失败，因为时钟驱动的刷新可以在单个不可逆的步骤中将瞬态漂移的学生复制到教师中。这一失败
tldr: 本研究发现在自我在线策略蒸馏中，教师更新的隔离期（更新之间完全冻结教师）而非教师年龄是实现稳定学习的关键结构属性，并提出诊断框架揭示了状态遗忘崩溃现象——短程最优的固定更新时间表在长程训练中会因时钟驱动的刷新将漂移的学生一次性不可逆地复制进教师而导致灾难性失败。
en_tdlr: This study establishes that isolation periods (complete teacher freezing between updates), rather than teacher age, are the key structural property enabling stable learning in self on-policy distillation, and uncovers state-oblivious collapse where optimal short-horizon fixed schedules catastrophically fail under long-horizon training due to clock-driven refreshes irreversibly copying a transiently drifting student into the teacher.
